import sys
MOD = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    parent = [0] * (n + 1)
    depth = [0] * (n + 1)
    total = 0

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        parts = list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split()))
        k = parts[0]
        edges = []

            v = parts[1 + 2*j]

                root_v = parent[root_v]
            total += (depth[v] + x) % MOD
            parent[i] = root_v
            depth[i] = (depth[v] + x) % MOD
            break
        else:
            parent[i] = 0
            depth[i] = 0

    print(total % MOD)
